desc: 邀请校内外优秀的实践者、创业者与研究者，分享他们在 AI 领域真实走过的路——不只是高光时刻，更是背后那些笨拙、迷茫与突破的过程。

en.desc: We invite outstanding practitioners, founders and researchers from on and off campus to share the real paths they have taken in AI: not just the highlights, but the clumsy, confusing moments and the breakthroughs behind them.

desc: 手把手教你快速上手一项新技术、新项目。每期聚焦一个主题，从零开始，带你搭建一个小作品，真正学以致用。

en.desc: Hands-on sessions that get you up to speed with a new technology or project fast. Each session focuses on one theme and takes you from zero to a small working project, so you can put what you learn into practice.

desc: DeepLearner 年度算法挑战赛，面向南通大学全体学生开放组队参赛。用生产问题检验真实能力，在协作与竞争中找到自己的边界。

en.desc: DeepLearner’s annual algorithm challenge, open to teams from across Nantong University. Real-world production problems put your skills to the test, and through collaboration and competition you find out where your limits are.

desc: 我们走进社区、学校与乡村，用 AI 做一点有意义的事。技术不是终点，让更多人受益才是。

en.desc: We go into communities, schools and villages to do something meaningful with AI. Technology isn’t the end goal; helping more people benefit from it is.
